fusions.name: Wind-Carried Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a fletched shaft at a target up to 10 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at the full 10 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Fletching Flurry
fusions.desc: Looses 3 feathered shafts in a spread, each dealing 3 damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Reading the Windage
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Feathered True
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
